battle.name: 中途島
battle.brief: 一張被截譯的電報，四支航空母艦打擊群在雲層下錯過第一次攻擊，俯衝轟炸機回頭再撲才改變一切。1942年6月4日至5日，日軍四艘艦隊空母在兩小時內相繼沉沒，雙方航空母艦對決第一次有了明確勝負。卡面的「企業」號是美軍攻勢的左拳：她的轟炸五中隊擊沉翔鶴、飛鷹，她的艦載機群把赤城、加賀燒成廢墟，而她自己在同日也被日本海軍最後一波反擊所傷。航艦在彈藥與飛機露天、燃油尚未倒盡時最脆弱，這一條規律在三天裡被反覆證明。

kit.name: 企業
kit.history: 約克鎮級。中途島、東所羅門、聖克魯斯與之後几乎所有太平洋艦隊行動都有她。倖存是損傷管制與美國補艦能力，不是幸運咒語。

countries: 中途島海戰於1942年6月4日至7日在中太平洋中途島環礁附近海域爆發，交戰雙方是美國太平洋艦隊與日本聯合艦隊。美軍方面，最高指揮為太平洋艦隊總司令海軍上將切斯特·尼米茲，實際出擊的是第16特遣艦隊，由海軍少將雷蒙德·斯普魯恩斯中將率領，以約克鎮級航艦「企業」號（CV-6）為旗艦，隊中另有「大黃蜂」號（CV-8），由第八驅逐艦戰隊的八艘驅逐艦護航，另有加油與補給單位在東北方候命。企業航空群為戰鬥六中隊（VB-6）、戰鬥六飛行中隊（VF-6）與轟炸五中隊（VS-5），大黃蜂配戰鬥八中隊（VB-8）、戰鬥八飛行中隊（VF-8）與魚雷八中隊（VT-8），六月初共出動約一百五十架次，中途島上的海軍陸戰隊飛行中隊與陸軍航空隊分頭負責近岸搜索與基地防空。日本方面，總策劃者是駐紮廣島灣的聯合艦隊總長山本五十六海軍大將，前線指揮是搭乘「赤城」號的第一機動部隊司令南雲忠一中將，轄第一艦隊的「赤城」「加賀」與第二艦隊的「翔鶴」「飛鷹」四艘艦隊空母，護衛為「熊」「鈴谷」兩艘重巡洋艦及第八驅逐艦戰隊，隸屬第一空軍艦隊的三個航空戰隊則分屬上述四艦。與此同時，第三艦隊的新式航母與主力留在印度洋，負責牽制英軍，掩護主力的側翼。
countriesEn: The Battle of Midway was fought from 4 to 7 June 1942 in the waters around Midway Atoll in the mid-Pacific, between the United States Pacific Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet. On the American side the overall command belonged to Fleet Admiral Chester W. Nimitz, Commander-in-Chief Pacific Fleet, while the force that actually sailed was Task Force 16 under Rear Admiral Raymond A. Spruance, built around the Yorktown-class carrier USS Enterprise (CV-6) with USS Hornet (CV-8) in company, screened by the eight destroyers of Destroyer Squadron 8, with an oiling and replenishment group waiting to the north-east. Enterprise's air group comprised Bombing Squadron 6 (VB-6), Fighter Squadron 6 (VF-6) and Bombing Squadron 5 (VS-5); Hornet carried Torpedo Squadron 8 (VT-8), Bombing Squadron 8 (VB-8) and Fighter Squadron 8 (VF-8). About 150 sorties were flown in early June, with the Marine fighter squadron and the Army air units stationed on Midway itself responsible for local search and for the defence of the island. On the Japanese side the plan was worked out by Fleet Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto, Combined Fleet commander-in-chief, anchored in Hiroshima Bay, and the field command belonged to Vice Admiral Chūichi Nagumo, commander of the First Mobile Fleet, who flew his flag in Akagi. Nagumo's force contained the four fleet carriers Akagi and Kaga of the First Carrier Division and Sōryū and Hiryū of the Second Carrier Division, screened by the heavy cruisers Kuma and Suzuya and by Destroyer Squadron 8; the three air groups of the First Air Fleet were allocated to those four hulls. At the same time the Third Carrier Division's new carriers and the main body stayed in the Indian Ocean, tying down the British and covering the flank of the main operation.
people: 美軍一側的決策鏈條短而清楚。尼米茲在珍珠港收到情報後不願攻擊目標，而是選擇設伏，因此主動放棄了中途島陸地的時間壓力；斯普魯恩斯中將指揮第16特遣艦隊，全軍保持無線電靜默直到攻擊發起。企業的航空群長是弗萊德里克·鄧肯上校，轟炸五中隊長是韋德·麥克盧斯基中校，他率領的SBD是擊沉翔鶴與飛鷹的刀刃；戰鬥六中隊長約翰·沃爾德倫中校，率領的魚雷機中隊在飛鷹身上報了血債；大黃蜂的戰鬥八中隊長羅伯特·布魯德中校，率隊在同日重創赤城與加賀，擊中赤城飛行甲板並引燃航空汽油的炸彈，出自企業戰鬥六中隊的攻擊。飛行中隊方面，企業的保羅·博伊德中校、維吉爾·鮑曼中校與大黃蜂的約翰·波爾特中校在整日空戰中各自擊落零式戰鬥機。情報環節的關鍵是「Hypo」站長約瑟夫·羅什福特，他的人馬持續破譯日軍JN-25密碼並推出「AF」就是中途島；日軍方面，山本五十六的方案在艦隊內部曾受反對，南雲忠一忠實執行命令，第二艦隊長山口多門指揮翔鶴與飛鷹的出擊，重巡洋艦部隊指揮官有馬敏次郎以「熊」「鈴谷」遮護航艦。
peopleEn: The American chain of command was short and clear. Having received the intelligence, Nimitz at Pearl Harbor chose to lie in wait rather than to strike the objective, accepting the loss of time on Midway in the islands; Rear Admiral Spruance commanded Task Force 16, and the whole force kept radio silence until the attack was under way. Enterprise's air group was led by Captain Donald B. Duncan; Bombing Squadron 5 was led by Lieutenant Commander Wade McClusky, whose SBDs were the blade that sank Sōryū and Hiryū; Bombing Squadron 6 under Lieutenant Commander John C. Waldron took the torpedo squadrons in the punishing attack on Hiryū; Bombing Squadron 8 of Hornet under Lieutenant Commander Robert P. Bruder struck Akagi and Kaga on the same day, and the bomb that set the aviation gasoline burning on Akagi's flight deck came from VB-6 of Enterprise. Among the fighter squadrons, Lieutenant Commander Paul Boyd and Lieutenant Commander Virgil Bowman of Enterprise and Lieutenant Commander John F. Bolt of Hornet each claimed Zero fighters that day. The decisive name in the intelligence chain was Joseph Rochefort, whose Station Hypo team worked the Japanese JN-25 cipher continuously and concluded that 'AF' meant Midway. On the Japanese side Yamamoto's plan had met opposition inside the fleet, Nagumo Chūichi carried the orders out faithfully, and Vice Admiral Tamon Yamaguchi led the Second Carrier Division's Sōryū and Hiryū into the attack, screened by the heavy cruiser detachment of Vice Admiral Taijirō Aritomo with Kuma and Suzuya.
kits: 卡面這件「企業」號是約克鎮級第二艘，1936年開工、1938年服役，滿載排水量約兩萬五千噸，爐機總出力約十二萬匹馬力，最高航速約三十九節，續航可達一萬餘海里，配九門五吋三十八倍徑高射炮與雙聯裝高射機炮，裝甲以飛行甲板與機庫區最為薄弱，航空群編制約三十架、戰時常駐兩百架上下。中途島一役，企業出動的是F4F野蠻式戰鬥機、SBD無畏式俯衝轟炸機與TBF鯊魚式魚雷機，關鍵一點是SBD-3配有俯衝剎車，得以在雲隙中以近乎垂直的角度投彈，而先前批次的SBD-2無法穿過雲層，導致第一次攻擊全部落空。日軍方面，翔鶴與飛鷹裝備九九式俯衝轟炸機（主力艦載型，可帶一千公斤炸彈）、九六式艦上攻擊機與九七式艦上魚雷機，赤城與加賀另載零式五二型戰鬥機；另有九七式艦上攻擊機攜帶九三式長程魚雷專門攻擊西向航線。日軍護衛艦與主力艦的火炮以二〇三毫米與一五二毫米為主，而美軍新墨西哥號與華盛頓號的十四吋主炮在同一上午與日軍巡洋艦、戰列艦對射，構成雙方最後一次戰列艦對戰。補給與運輸方面，雙方都靠油船在洋面維持燃料，靠驅逐艦與高速油船輸送人員與備件，企業的修理能力則仰賴夏威夷的船廠與西岸的船廠分擔。
kitsEn: The piece on the card is the second Yorktown-class carrier, laid down in 1936 and commissioned in 1938, of about 25,000 tons full load, some 120,000 shaft horsepower, a top speed near 29 knots and a range of well over 10,000 miles, carrying nine 5-inch/38 guns and twin anti-aircraft mounts, with the flight deck and hangar areas the weakest parts of her protection and an air group of about thirty aircraft, in wartime two hundred or more. At Midway Enterprise flew the F4F Wildcat, the SBD Dauntless and the TBF Avenger, and one technical point was decisive: the SBD-3 carried dive brakes, so it could deliver its bomb at close to a right angle through a break in the overcast, while the earlier SBD-2 batches could not descend through cloud, which is why the first strike missed entirely. On the Japanese side Sōryū and Hiryū carried the Type 99 dive bomber, the carrier version able to carry a 1,000 kilogram bomb, together with the Type 96 carrier attack aircraft and the Type 97 carrier torpedo bomber, while Akagi and Kaga also carried the A6M2 Zero fighter; a Type 97 attack aircraft armed with the long-range Type 93 torpedo was used against the western route. The Japanese escorts and capital ships fought with 203 mm and 152 mm guns, while the 14-inch guns of USS New Mexico and USS Washington duelled with the Japanese cruisers and battleships in the same morning, the last battleship-versus-battleship action of the war. In the background of all of this, both sides ran their ships on tanker-supplied fuel, moved men and spares by destroyer and by fast cargo ship, and Enterprise's repairs in the end rested on the yards at Pearl Harbor and on the west coast.
tactics: 山本五十六的方案代號「K作戰」，是把四支打擊艦隊分成南北兩路夾擊中途島：主力由西北方向撲向目標，另一支由北方插入，另以一支由輕巡洋艦「金」「阿賀野」與驅逐艦「若葉」「荒潮」「日向」組成的分遣隊北上阿留申群島，以攻擊阿圖島與基斯卡島的兩棲牽制行動，把美軍注意力拉向北方；同時聯合艦隊主力在印度洋活動，使美軍無法集中力量。時間表排得很緊：6月4日凌晨日本艦隊發起攻擊，先以魚雷機低空夜襲美軍巡洋艦與驅逐艦，再以俯衝轟炸機攻擊航艦護衛艦群，美軍第一波攻擊因雲層未能投彈，日軍卻把打擊力量分次散射，沒有集中成一次總攻，錯失了最佳時機。中午企業與大黃蜂的俯衝轟炸機各編兩波、連續打擊航艦：一波重創赤城與加賀，一波擊中飛鷹並擊沉翔鶴，兩艘日艦的飛行甲板與機庫同時起火，航空汽油在機庫裡燃成一片；下午大黃蜂的魚雷機群自北面突入飛鷹，四枚魚雷命中，飛鷹在四小時內沉沒，企業的魚雷機群同樣損失慘重，僅三架飛到目標。日軍以飛鷹殘存機群在傍晚再攻擊企業，一枚炸彈穿過飛行甲板在機庫甲板爆炸，企業當日傷亡三十七人，經搶修後仍能作戰。潛艇「海鯊」在凌晨同時攻擊「熊」「鈴谷」兩艘重巡洋艦，迫使其退出掩護位置，這條戰線也牽制了日軍的注意力。整體看，這是一場計畫周密、執行斷裂的戰役：日軍把打擊拆成數小時的碎片，美軍則靠情報、燃料存量與俯衝轟炸機的複航能力，把碎片補成致命的一擊。
tacticsEn: Yamamoto's plan, designated Operation K, split the striking force into northern and northern-western groups converging on Midway, while a detachment of the light cruisers Kinu and Amagi with the destroyers Wakaba, Arashio and Hiyodori was to move north to the Aleutians, where an amphibious feint against Attu and Kiska was to pull American attention away; at the same time the Combined Fleet main body operated in the Indian Ocean, preventing the Americans from concentrating their strength. The timetable was tight. In the early hours of 4 June the Japanese force attacked, opening with a low-level torpedo strike against the American cruisers and destroyers, then sending dive bombers at the carriers' screen. The American first strike failed to bomb through an overcast, while Japan split its striking power into separate waves instead of concentrating it into one massed attack, and missed the moment. Around midday the dive bombers of Enterprise and of Hornet went in again in two waves each: one wave gutted Akagi and Kaga, another hit Hiryū and sank Sōryū, with flight decks and hangars burning simultaneously and aviation gasoline turning the hangar decks into infernos. In the afternoon the torpedo squadrons of Hornet attacked Hiryū from the north, four torpedoes hit, and Hiryū went down within four hours; the torpedo squadrons of Enterprise were cut down just as badly and only three of them reached the target. In the evening the surviving aircraft of Hiryū struck back at Enterprise: one bomb passed through the flight deck and detonated on the hangar deck, killing thirty-seven men, and damage control kept the ship in the fight. The submarine Nautilus attacked Kuma and Suzuya in the small hours, drawing them away from their screening stations and adding to the confusion. In the end this was a well-planned but badly executed battle: Japan broke its attack into fragments across several hours, while the Americans, thanks to intelligence, fuel state and the range of their dive bombers, stitched the fragments together into one lethal blow.
data: 可查的數字大致勾勒出這一場對決的規模。時間上，主要交鋒集中在1942年6月4日與5日，戰役以追擊殘餘兵力收尾至6月7日。距離上，中途島距珍珠港約一千三百海里、距舊金山約二千八百海里，6月5日一架日本偵察機發現美軍艦隊回航；日軍四艘航艦在三十六小時內被判定失去作戰能力。兵力上，日軍出動四艘艦隊空母，艦載機約二百四十餘架，第一日美軍即損失機約一百二十架；美軍出動企業、大黃蜂兩艦，艦載機總數相近，另從中途島陸基出動偵察機與戰鬥機。損耗上，日軍沉沒四艘艦隊空母、艦員約二千八百至三千人（含陣亡與失蹤），重巡洋艦「熊」「鈴谷」重傷，驅逐艦一沉數傷；美軍沉「約克鎮」號與「哈曼」號，另有三艘驅逐艦在6月4日上午的魚雷攻擊中沉沒，損失飛機約一百五十架、人員約三百餘人，約克鎮號上獲救者逾二千人。日軍攻擊飛鷹的航空隊因迎擊美軍魚雷機而損失約十分之一的飛機。企業號本身被一枚炸彈重創，三十七人死，於夏威夷修理約兩週後重返前線。關於日軍各艦陣亡人數與逐波攻擊的時間細節，各家記載互有出入，逐日戰損表多已散佚，只宜視為概數。
dataEn: The available figures sketch the scale of this confrontation. In time, the main clash fell on 4 and 5 June 1942, with the pursuit of what was left of the Japanese force running on to 7 June. In distance, Midway lies about 1,300 nautical miles from Pearl Harbor and some 2,800 from San Francisco, and on 5 June a Japanese reconnaissance aircraft sighted the American force turning home; within thirty-six hours all four Japanese carriers were judged unable to continue the fight. In men and machines, Japan put four fleet carriers and roughly 240 to 250 aircraft into the battle, and the Americans lost about 120 aircraft on the first day alone; the United States committed Enterprise and Hornet with comparable numbers embarked, plus reconnaissance aircraft and fighters operating from the island. In losses, Japan lost four fleet carriers and about 2,800 to 3,000 officers and men killed or missing, with the heavy cruisers Kuma and Suzuya badly damaged, one destroyer sunk and several more damaged; the Americans lost Yorktown and Hammann, three further destroyers went down in the torpedo attack of the morning of 4 June, about 150 aircraft were lost and something over 300 men killed, and more than two thousand men were rescued from Yorktown's deck. Roughly a tenth of the Japanese air group that attacked Hiryū was lost meeting the American torpedo squadrons. Enterprise herself was gutted by a single bomb, thirty-seven of her men died, and she was back in the front line after about two weeks of repairs in Hawaii. For Japanese casualties aboard each individual carrier and for the timing of each wave of attacks the sources differ, and the day-by-day loss tables are largely lost, so these figures should be treated as approximate.
cause: 中途島之戰是日本主動挑起的決戰，背景有三層。第一層是戰略：珍珠港重創美國太平洋艦隊後，日本以為美國主力已廢，準備東進，1942年4月18日美國空襲日本本土的杜立利空襲則被視為對這種輕率的報復，證明美國還能反手打回來，於是日本決定先以一次大規模航母打擊把殘餘的美國航母連同基地航空力量一次拔除，代號「MO作戰」，中途島正選在珍珠港與夏威夷之間航程的一半，作為引誘美國艦隊出動的誘餌。第二層是海軍內部的技術信念：山本五十六認為美國艦隊會因航速較快而追擊日本打擊艦隊，主動接近日軍，因此願意承擔更大風險分兵兩路，連原 Hawaii 群島、阿留申與阿留申方向都計劃了牽制行動。第三層是美軍的準備：以「Hypo」站為主的情報單位自1940年起持續破譯JN-25，並從「AF」一詞推斷出目標即中途島；同時「約克鎮」號在珊瑚海海戰後僅用約兩週完成修理便再度出海，帶著臨時補上的裝甲帶參加攔截。密碼、速度與修理能力三項加起來，才有了珍珠港後第一次主動出擊的機會。
causeEn: The Battle of Midway was a decisive engagement that Japan chose to fight, and it rested on three layers of background. First, strategy: after Pearl Harbor had crippled the American Pacific Fleet, Japan assumed the American battle force was spent and prepared to move east, and the Doolittle raid of 18 April 1942 against the Japanese home islands was read as proof that America could still strike back. Japan therefore resolved to remove the remaining American carriers and their land-based air power in a single large carrier strike, Operation MO, and it chose Midway, roughly halfway between Pearl Harbor and Hawaii, as the bait to draw the American fleet out. Second, a technical conviction inside the Japanese navy: Yamamoto believed the faster American ships would chase the Japanese striking force and close in voluntarily, so he accepted greater risk and split his force, with diversions planned for the Aleutians as well. Third, American preparation: an intelligence organisation centred on Station Hypo had been breaking JN-25 since 1940 and had worked out from the single designation 'AF' that the objective was Midway; and Yorktown, having fought at the Coral Sea, completed her repairs in about two weeks and sailed again with her belt armour patched in, to take part in the interception. It was the sum of codebreaking, speed and yard capacity that created the first American counterstroke after Pearl Harbor.
impact: 中途島之後，日本海軍的攻勢能力被削去了一大塊，但它真正的損失不是四條艦體，而是無法補充的飛行員與難以再複製的組織經驗：二百四五十名-trained 艦載機飛行員與數千名艦員一次性消失，而日本航空兵的訓練產能遠低於消耗速度，之後雖然靠召集與轉移維持了隊伍規模，卻再也無法形成同等密度的連續打擊。戰略上，美軍第一次在太平洋上取得攻勢主動權，中途島與環礁成了日本外圍的第一道屏障被突破的證明；日本被迫把「進攻」改為「保衛帝國本土」的方向，戰略重心轉向所羅門群島，美國於是得到了一條可以逐島消耗的戰線。日本聯合艦隊作為一個以航母為核心的打擊體系，自此不再具備決定性作用，山本五十六本人於1943年4月在空中被擊落身亡，方案設計者先一步出局。德國與日本在歐洲與太平洋的攻勢同步受挫，軸心國的整體戰略因此中止。中美與英美之間則由此認定以航母為核心的遠洋打擊是有意義的兵種方向，航空母艦兵團與艦載機的體系化訓練在美國海軍被制度化。對日本而言，這場戰役還暴露了一個此後反覆出現的結構性問題：護衛與制空不足、戰機補充太慢、艦隊被封鎖在補給線之外。
impactEn: After Midway Japan lost a large part of its offensive power, but the real loss was not four hulls but irreplaceable aircrew and organisational experience: some 240 to 250 trained carrier pilots and several thousand sailors disappeared in a single day, while Japanese air training output was far below the rate of consumption, and though the squadrons were later kept up to strength by recall and transfer, they could never again mount a strike of the same density. Strategically the Americans won the initiative in the Pacific for the first time, and Midway and its reefs were shown to be penetrable, so Japan was forced to abandon the idea of expansion and turn towards defending the home islands, shifting the weight of effort to the Solomon Islands and giving the United States a line of islands on which to grind the Japanese down. The Combined Fleet, as a carrier-centred striking system, was never again capable of deciding anything, and Yamamoto himself was shot down and killed in the air in April 1943, the author of the plan removed before the results of it could mature. Germany's and Japan's offensives in Europe and the Pacific were checked at the same moment, and the Axis strategy as a whole was halted. Between the Anglo-American and American-Japanese navies the battle confirmed that the carrier strike was a meaningful arm, and the institutional training of carrier air groups and air-sea task forces was systematised in the US Navy. For Japan the campaign also exposed a structural weakness that recurred for the rest of the war: inadequate screening and air cover, fighter replacement too slow, and a fleet boxed in beyond its own supply lines.
result: 結局是日本艦隊主力在三十六小時內退出戰鬥。6月4日上午，日軍第一次攻擊被美國攔截機打散並損失一批魚雷機；中午，企業與大黃蜂的俯衝轟炸機連續打擊，赤城與加賀飛行甲板與機庫同時起火，赤城當日傍晚被放棄、加賀次日被放棄；同一批攻擊擊中飛鷹並擊沉翔鶴，兩艦分別在當日與翌日沉沒。6月5日下午，企業與大黃蜂的魚雷機自北面攻擊飛鷹，四枚魚雷命中，飛鷹在當夜沉沒，殘存飛機傍晚的最後一次反擊重創企業但未能扭轉局勢。日軍四艘艦隊空母全滅、艦員傷亡慘重，被迫中止針對中途島的作戰，6月7日殘餘兵力撤離，逐漸回到珍珠港一帶。美軍方面沉了「約克鎮」號與「哈曼」號，另有多艘驅逐艦受損，約克鎮號雖經搶修仍因進水過多而放棄，機上人員由驅逐艦接走。1942年6月4日成為有史以來第一次航空母艦對決有明確勝負的一日：這一天之後，美軍在太平洋取得攻勢主動權，日本被壓回守勢，而卡面上的「企業」號，則是這場轉折中被錘煉出來的刀刃與標誌——她的倖存不是運氣，而是全艦在十分鐘內靠搶修、靠管制的紀律撐住的事實。
resultEn: The outcome was that the main body of the Japanese fleet was out of the fight within thirty-six hours. On the morning of 4 June the first Japanese attack was scattered by the American fighters and cost a batch of torpedo aircraft. Around midday the dive bombers of Enterprise and Hornet struck in succession: Akagi and Kaga had their flight decks and hangars burning at the same time, Akagi was abandoned that evening and Kaga the following day; the same wave hit Hiryū and sank Sōryū, one on the day itself and the other the next. In the afternoon of 5 June the torpedo squadrons of Enterprise and Hornet struck Hiryū from the north, four torpedoes hit, and Hiryū went down that night; the last counter-stroke by Hiryū's remaining aircraft in the evening damaged Enterprise badly but changed nothing. All four Japanese fleet carriers were lost, casualties among their crews were heavy, and the operation against Midway was called off, the remnants withdrawing by 7 June and making their way back towards Pearl Harbor. On the American side Yorktown and Hammann were sunk and several destroyers damaged; Yorktown, though repaired as far as possible, was abandoned for too much flooding, and her aircraft group was taken off by the destroyers. 4 June 1942 became the first day in history on which a carrier-versus-carrier engagement produced a clear result: from that day the United States held the initiative in the Pacific and Japan was pushed back onto the defensive, while the Enterprise on the card face was the blade tempered by that turning point. Her survival was not luck but fact: in the space of ten minutes the whole ship was held together by repair parties and by the discipline of damage control.
